text: Not too great. This is cheap and light. Does not drain and holds a lot of water.

【Premium Material】Using high quality resin material, the soap dish is water-proof, scratch-proof and non-toxic and non-irritating smell. Meanwhile, this tray is not affected by moisture, mold or mildew.

【Multifunctional Storage Holder】You can use Luxspire soap dish in the kitchen for placing your sponge or dish cleaning balls. Our rectangular soap dish can be used not only in the bathroom but also in the bathtub, kitchen, washstand, countertop, shower, sink, basin, etc.

【Marble Look Soap Dish Holder】 This marble designed tray is the perfect addition to any home decor, great for bathrooms, powder rooms, kitchens, laundry, utility rooms, workshops, and garages. Whether you're buying our draining soap dish for yourself or as a gift for family or friends, its unique and elegant style means it will look good.
